listing.name: Super Smash Bros. Ultimate (ssbu-arena)
listing.summary: SSBU Arena is an independent Windows fork for competitive one-on-one Super Smash Bros. Ultimate. It uses your own 13.0.4 or 13.0.5 game. The project tested rollback with two windows on one PC. Ranked play and replays are planned.

steps.title: Check your original game files
steps.instruction: Use your own 13.0.4 or 13.0.5 game dump and keys, with any matching updates or DLC you own. Separate firmware needs are unclear.

steps.title: Follow the project’s setup
steps.instruction: Check the Windows 10 or 11 x64 guide against the selected release. The README describes a local source install, while v0.2.7 contains SSBU-Arena.exe, a player ZIP and a manifest.

references.title: Version and platform notes
references.instruction: The reported network tests used one computer. Linux and macOS guide links do not establish confirmed gameplay or CPU support there.

decisions.rationale: The repository moved from Acid236 to SSBUArena. GitHub only lets an administrator of the original repository transfer it, and Acid236 authored its history and remains a contributor. Keep the Portcove identity and listing; only its project location changes.
